methodology: Forecast trajectories on live Polymarket/Kalshi markets: a fresh point-in-time forecast each day (latest price + latest news, no look-ahead) until the market resolves, then every snapshot is scored. Skill vs market = market Brier − model Brier, reported by forecast horizon; long-horizon skill is the meaningful signal.
